scope: Samples were immunoprecipitated using EZview Red anti-FLAG M2 affinity gel (Millipore Sigma) for 2 h at 4 °C on a rotary shaker.
The bands corresponding to USP18 that co-precipitated with ISG were excised into 1 mm cubes, and destained for 20 min.

Human USP18 was exogenously expressed in HEK293T cells and subsequently immunoprecipitated. Immunoprecipitated samples were washed on beads and eluted with SDS sample buffer. Precipitates were separated by SDS-PAGE and stained with Coomassie blue. The band corresponding to USP18 was cut out, trypsin digested and analyzed by mass spectrometry.
